ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to confirm you are at the store when you check in or count the cash drawer.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Your location is only used while the app is open, to confirm you are at the store when you check in or count the cash drawer.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Your location is only used while the app is open, to confirm you are at the store when you check in or count the cash drawer.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to verify your face at check-in, scan kiosk QR codes and scan product barcodes when selling.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is only needed by the camera for face verification videos. No audio is kept.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo access lets you pick a profile picture or attach photos in chat.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Lets you save QR codes and images to your photo library.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID lets you sign in faster.
